title: Hexagon
description: Draw a white regular hexagon with a flat top and bottom on a black background. Its center is the center of the canvas and every edge is 0.5 from that center. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 in both directions.
hintText: A hexagon has three pairs of parallel edges. Use the three directions (1, 0), (0.5, 0.866) and (-0.5, 0.866). abs(dot(uv, direction)) is the distance to both edges of a pair at once. The shape's distance is the max() of the three, minus 0.5.
